overview_text: The combined major in Africana studies and criminal justice offers students an opportunity to integrate their studies of both disciplines. Africana studies is an interdisciplinary field focused on the experiences of Black people throughout the world. Criminal justice provides an interdisciplinary and experiential education in the causes and consequences of crime and responses to the criminal justice system. The combined major explores the historical, practical, and theoretical relationships between the two disciplines. In addition to considering significant points of intersection, students examine how insights from Africana studies can be brought to bear on the critical and systematic analysis of the cultural, political, social, economic, and historical experiences of the African diaspora in relation to criminal justice systems across the globe.
